## What I do

I design APIs and data models, build React and Next.js interfaces, and take customer-facing features from concept through deployment. Stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, C# / .NET, PostgreSQL, AWS, Cloudflare, Docker, OpenAI.

Shipped software supporting 37K+ daily orders, 180+ integration configurations, 15+ churches, and 200+ schools.
